description:
We are looking for a Full­stack Ruby developer responsible for building and supporting our many Ruby  applications. Your primary responsibility will be to design and develop these applications, and to coordinate  with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure. Thus, a commitment to  collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and building quality products is essential. Our ideal  candidate should be opinionated and passionate about the software they build and enjoy collaboration. Candidates should have experience working with Ruby frameworks other than Rails and follow a test- driven development approach. Previous experience working together with a remote team is a plus. 
 

 Responsibilities: 
 • Communicate and collaborate with our current team to solve problems and discuss best  programming practices. 
 • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable Ruby code. 

 • Work closely with different departments and peers to develop software that enhances user  experience and productivity 
 • Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the applications Identify  issues, bugs, and bottlenecks and devise solutions to these problems 
 • Use testdriven development to ensure code quality and reliability. 

 

 Skills & Qualifications : 
 


 • Ability to quickly learn new Ruby frameworks, libraries, and implementation methods Extensive experience building, supporting, and scaling customerfacing software .
 • Good understanding of the syntax of Ruby and its nuances. 

 • Solid understanding of objectoriented programming. 

 • Skills for writing reusable Ruby libraries and publishing gems 

 • Advanced SQL experience using databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL & ability to write efficient queries 

 • Understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application 

 • Able to create database schema's that represent and support business processes 

 • Familiarity with development aiding tools. 

 • Ability to set timelines, goals, and selfmanage your schedule
